verdict.rationale: Pylon's agents clearly run standalone inside Pylon's own helpdesk, assigned to issues across Slack, email, chat widget and other channels (pylon-docs-18, pylon-docs-40, pylon-docs-70). For external systems, the evidence shows only a Salesforce CRM integration that pushes AI conversation summaries to Accounts and maps accounts (pylon-docs-33, pylon-docs-64, pylon-docs-55); this is one-way context sync, not running inside an existing helpdesk. Missing for 10: any evidence of the agent embedding in Zendesk or Intercom, two-way ticket sync with an external helpdesk, and Salesforce ticket/case sync beyond account summaries.
